main.remarks: Denies policy evaluation when the supplied policy context does not provide a subject string.

method.name: Evaluate
method.summary: Evaluate whether a subject is present in the supplied policy context.
method.returns: Deny when the subject is missing or whitespace; otherwise allow.

method.name: EvaluateAsync
method.summary: Evaluate asynchronously whether a subject is present in the supplied policy context.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous stage evaluation.
method.returns: Deny when the subject is missing or whitespace; otherwise allow.
